bsbm.label: Q3
bsbm.sparql: SELECT ?product WHERE { ?product a bsbm:Product ; bsbm:productFeature ?f ; bsbm:productPropertyNumeric1 ?v1 ; bsbm:productPropertyNumeric3 ?v3 . FILTER(?v1 > 350 && ?v3 < 950) } LIMIT 10

bsbm.label: Q4
bsbm.sparql: SELECT ?product ?label WHERE { { ?product bsbm:productFeature ?f } UNION { ?product rdfs:label ?label . FILTER regex(?label,"en") } } ORDER BY ?label LIMIT 10

bsbm.label: Q5
bsbm.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?product WHERE { ?product bsbm:productFeature ?f . ?p2 bsbm:productFeature ?f . FILTER(?product != ?p2) } LIMIT 5

bsbm.sparql: SELECT ?review ?title WHERE { ?review a bsbm:Review ; dc:title ?title ; bsbm:reviewFor ?product } LIMIT 10

bsbm.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?offer ?vendor WHERE { ?offer bsbm:vendor ?vendor ; bsbm:product ?product } LIMIT 10

bsbm.label: Q11
bsbm.sparql: SELECT ?review ?rating WHERE { ?review bsbm:rating1 ?r1 ; bsbm:rating2 ?r2 . BIND((?r1+?r2)/2 AS ?rating) } LIMIT 10
